zh: 答案只是“大写字母个数减去小写字母个数”，数字、空格和标点都不影响结果，空字符串的结果为 0。
不需要分别统计两种字母再相减，可以一边扫描一边维护一个累计值：大写字母贡献 +1，小写字母贡献 −1，其余字符贡献 0。
把整行原样读入（保留空格，不要按空白切分后丢掉字符），逐个字符判断它是否落在 A..Z 或 a..z 中并更新累计值，最后输出；结果可能是负数。
en: The answer is just the number of uppercase letters minus the number of lowercase letters; digits, spaces and punctuation do not matter, and an empty string gives 0.
There is no need to count the two kinds separately and subtract; keep one running value while scanning: an uppercase letter contributes +1, a lowercase letter -1, and anything else 0.

Read the whole line as is (keep the spaces; do not split on whitespace and lose characters), check for each character whether it falls in A..Z or a..z and update the running value, then print it; the result may be negative.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Scan the characters: an uppercase letter adds one, a lowercase letter subtracts one, and other characters leave the running value unchanged.

## Why it is correct

Every uppercase character contributes +1, every lowercase character contributes -1, and other characters contribute zero. Adding them up one by one gives exactly the difference between the two counts.

## Complexity

Time O(n), extra space O(1).
